query: What is our time off policy for contractors?
probe: coverage gap — the PTO policy does not mention contractors
response:
I couldn’t find a contractor-specific time off policy in our internal docs. The PTO policy that’s documented applies to “employees” and describes a flexible/unlimited PTO approach (including company holidays and sick leave), with requests submitted in Workday. Source: pto_policy.md (People Ops; effective Jan 1, 2024; last updated Feb 1, 2024)

For contractors, time off is typically handled via the contractor’s agreement/SOW (often unpaid and coordinated directly with the hiring manager), but that contractor guidance isn’t spelled out in the PTO policy document I found.

What to do:
1) Check the contractor’s contract/SOW for time-off and holiday terms.
2) If you need an official Acme standard, email People Ops (listed in the PTO doc) to confirm what applies to contractors. Source: pto_policy.md (Questions section)
